title: Cap. IV Arg. 5 Sol close: Minor — faith a destined means, not a foreseen condition of election
pass_a_gloss: Concerning the Minor, which is contained in express words of Scripture, there is no need that I say anything: for from what has been said it may easily be understood that thence it cannot be proved that faith in election ought to be considered as a foreseen condition, and antecedent of election, but as a means destined and to be conferred on those whom God elected, and destined to be adopted.
pass_b_english: On the Minor, which sits in express Scripture words, little need be added: from what is said it is plain you cannot prove from it that faith in election must be taken as a foreseen condition antecedent to election — but as a means destined and to be given to those God elected and destined for adoption.
source_text: De Minore, quae expressis Scripturae verbis continetur, non opus est aliquid dicam: ex dictis enim facile intelligatur, inde non posse probari, fidem in electione debere considerari ut conditionem praevisam, et electionis antecedaneam, sed ut medium illis destinatum et conferendum quos Deus elegit, et adoptandos destinavit.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. IV Arg. 5 Sol rem. + Arg. 6 section 380. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap4_arg6_densify. Honest partial.
